# Nehemiah’s Quick Prayer (Nehemiah 2:4)

## Emotional Focus
Quick prayers in the middle of hard work.

## Key KJV
“So I prayed to the God of heaven.” (Nehemiah 2:4)

## Gentle Retelling
While talking to the king, Nehemiah sent a quick prayer to God. God answered and helped him rebuild the wall.

## Coloring Prompt

## Read-Along Flow + Response
